author: Netuxx
body:
I was watching Tecky's video about his rage quit. Instead of watching the video i was focusing on the chat messages. There were a lot of reports but that was all, just reports. Nothing like "Confirmed hacker" or something like that...

My ideas are:
  1. Make every report with specific number.
  2. Make a confirm report command. So it will tell every staff member if a report is going to be "checked" to see if the player reporting is right and it will teleport the staff member to the server from where the report has been sended. It could be /report check (reportNumber)
  3. Tell the player who reported if the hacker/cheater has been punished or not.
Thanks for reading and sorry for my bad english.
~Netux
